d: to become haughty in one’s attitude toward others
a state of pride or arrogance, but with the implication of complete lack of basis for such an attitude
(derivative of {L:ἀλαζονεία<SDBG:ἀλαζονεία:000000>} ‘pretentious pride,’ {D:88.219}) one who is pretentiously proud and given to bragging about it
a state of pride which is without basis or justification
pertaining to being proud without basis or justification
(a figurative extension of meaning of τυφόομαι ‘to be crazy, to be demented,’ not occurring in the NT) to be so arrogant as to be practically demented
to become puffed up with pride, with the probable implication of being disparaging toward others
a state of ostentatious pride or arrogance bordering on insolence
to have an unwarranted pride in oneself or in one’s accomplishments
pertaining to being arrogant or proud
to have an arrogant, haughty attitude
(a figurative extension of meaning of ὕψωμα ‘height,’ not occurring in the NT) an exaggerated evaluation of what one is or of what one has done
to have an arrogant, haughty attitude
(a figurative extension of meaning of φυσιόω ‘to puff up, to inflate,’ not occurring in the NT) to cause someone to be proud, arrogant, or haughty
(a figurative extension of meaning of φυσίωσις ‘inflation,’ not occurring in the NT) an inflated, puffed up, exaggerated view of one’s own importance
pertaining to being arrogant as the result of self-will and stubbornness
